title: Italy Lion:
title_q: “We Are a Family, We Are 40 Members”
headline: A Lion from Orbassano says his club of 40 is a family, and the club and the town became important to each other.
story: He speaks Italian. His club in Orbassano, Italy is a family of 40 members: friends who get along well, do service and are good together. He has been a Lion for more than 10 years. For him it was love at first sight: the club became important for Orbassano, and Orbassano important for them.

The ending opens up to the world: enjoy every single nation at the convention, a world that is equal but totally different from ours. Warm, proud, a little formal. This ending talks about the convention, so Atdhe decides if this is an evergreen cut or a convention cut.

transcript:
Transcripts of IMG_7834, IMG_7836 and IMG_7835 (Italy Lion, Orbassano, Hong Kong Convention). He speaks Italian: these lines are an automatic English translation. Times are mm:ss per sentence in each source file. “Urbassano” is Orbassano.
IMG_7834.MOV
[00:00] I'm happy to be a Lions fan for more than 10 years, I come from Italy, my club is the Lions Club Urbassano, we
[00:09] are a family, we are 40 members, we are friends, we get along well, we do service and we are good together.
[00:16] I recommend coming to the convention because there is the whole world and many experiences to feel but also to bring to others.
IMG_7836.MOV
[00:01] It's been more than 10 years since I joined the Lions Club in Orbassano, thanks to the friends who attended the club and who
[00:08] invited me to join them.
[00:11] It was a love at first sight, the service, the community service, being an integral part of the community made us important for Orbassano
[00:23] and Orbassano important for us.
[00:25] We have done many different services, especially in the health sector with our medical staff and with the assistance when there was the pandemic.
IMG_7835.MOV
[00:00] The main advice is to enjoy every single nation present in this convention,
[00:06] to immerse yourself in a world that is equal but totally different from ours.
